sentences.text: Clause 7.4 imposes foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding for all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.
The RBI’s 2025 pre-payment-charges directions are no longer in force on the as-of date, and the 2014 foreclosure-charges circular is also no longer in force.

The only current RBI rule finding provided on prepayment charges is for UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 260, but its applicability is unknown because the rate type is missing, so compliance cannot be confirmed from the evidence.

missing.searched: Current RBI rules on prepayment/foreclosure charges for an individual, non-business term-loan borrower at a Tier 3 UCB; the provided rule finding for UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 260 is applicability-unknown without rate_type.
